description: This file contains unit tests for the utf8_strnwidth and utf8_strwidth functions, focusing on multi-byte Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and mixed strings, as well as ANSI sequences and string alignment functions.

methods.name: void test_utf8_width__strnwidth_chinese(void)
methods.description: Tests utf8_strnwidth with various Chinese strings, verifying correct width calculations

methods.name: void test_utf8_width__strwidth_chinese(void)
methods.description: Tests utf8_strwidth with Chinese and mixed strings to confirm total width calculations

methods.name: void test_utf8_width__strnwidth_japanese_korean(void)
methods.description: Verifies utf8_strnwidth with Japanese and Korean strings, ensuring they count as double-width characters

methods.name: void test_utf8_width__strnwidth_cjk_with_ansi(void)
methods.description: Tests utf8_strnwidth with ANSI escape sequences and CJK characters to ensure sequences are ignored in width calculations

methods.name: void test_utf8_width__strbuf_utf8_align(void)
methods.description: Verifies string alignment functions with CJK characters for left, right, and middle alignments
